quality_summary: Only the 2 Poly Haven concrete barriers are photorealistic scans. All 20 Poly Pizza models are stylized low-poly (Quaternius / Poly by Google / community) — honest, curated, CC0/CC-BY, mobile-friendly, but NOT photorealistic. No photorealistic truck exists in any free CC0 source found; a photorealistic hero truck would need a paid/commisioned model or a custom build. Poly Haven scanned trees were REJECTED: 60-950MB .bin files, 200k-2M tris each — unusable on mobile web.
scale_note: Poly Pizza GLBs do NOT share one unit system: Quaternius files carry x100 node scales and land near real metres; Poly by Google / jeremy / KolosStudios files are in arbitrary units (dump_truck, tanker_truck, stop_sign, steering_wheel in mm). bbox_dims_m above is the TRUE world-space size after node transforms — normalize each asset to its intended_use target size in game code. Do NOT trust raw model scale.

assets.name: Truck
assets.author: Quaternius
assets.notes: Quaternius flat-shaded low-poly. NOT photorealistic. Clean separate wheel meshes (good for steering/spin). World size already ~real truck scale.

assets.name: Pickup Truck
assets.author: Quaternius
assets.notes: Quaternius flat-shaded low-poly. NOT photorealistic. Separate wheel meshes.

assets.name: Dump truck
assets.author: jeremy
assets.notes: Low-poly (jeremy). NOT photorealistic. Single mesh, no separate wheels/dump bed. Source units unscaled: raw bbox 6.0x5.2x10.5 units — normalize in game to ~2.5w x 3h x 7l m.

assets.name: Truck Tank
assets.author: KolosStudios
assets.notes: Low-poly (KolosStudios). NOT photorealistic. Odd non-uniform node scales; world bbox 10.9x4.7x4.4 — normalize in game to ~2.5w x 3h x 8l m.

assets.name: Cargo Truck
assets.author: J-Toastie
assets.notes: Low-poly (J-Toastie). NOT photorealistic. 8 meshes incl. separate wheels. World size plausible (1.7w x 2.4h x 6.7l m) but narrow — scale x1.4 if used as hero truck.

assets.name: Trees
assets.author: Quaternius
assets.notes: Quaternius tree cluster (several trees in one file). NOT photorealistic. 32k tris + 3.4MB is heavy for a roadside tree — use sparingly or split; prefer pine_trees for mass planting.

assets.name: Pine Trees
assets.author: Quaternius
assets.notes: Quaternius pine cluster. NOT photorealistic. Best value tree: 3,666 tris, 99KB.

assets.name: Maple Trees
assets.author: Quaternius

assets.name: House
assets.author: Quaternius

assets.name: Town House
assets.author: Quaternius

assets.name: Big Building

assets.name: Shop

assets.name: Traffic Barrier

assets.notes: Quaternius barrier. Tiny (364 tris, 26KB). Good for roadworks.

assets.name: Traffic Cone
assets.author: Quaternius

assets.name: Sign
assets.author: Quaternius

assets.name: Stop sign
assets.author: Poly by Google
assets.notes: Poly by Google stop sign. Source units inconsistent (raw bbox 8x231x75) — normalize in game to ~2.5m tall.

assets.name: Traffic Light
assets.author: Quaternius

assets.name: Streetlight
assets.author: Quaternius

assets.name: Steering wheel
assets.author: Poly by Google
assets.notes: Poly by Google steering wheel. Low-poly, NOT photorealistic, but the only steering-wheel model found. Source units are millimetres (344mm diameter = correct real size if read as mm). 5 meshes.

assets.name: Shipping Container
assets.author: Quaternius
assets.notes: Quaternius container. 1,336 tris. Use as cargo load on the container truck / depot prop.

assets.name: Concrete Road Barrier
assets.author: Amal Kumar
assets.notes: Poly Haven PHOTOREALISTIC scan (author Amal Kumar). The only truly photorealistic models in this set. 60,928 tris is heavy per unit — use sparingly or add LOD; 1K textures embedded (diffuse+normal+ARM).

assets.name: Concrete Road Barrier 02
assets.author: Amal Kumar
assets.intended_use: Highway concrete crash barrier variant (photorealistic scan)
assets.notes: Poly Haven PHOTOREALISTIC scan (author Amal Kumar). Lighter variant: 23,822 tris. Prefer this one for repeated barriers.

not_included.what: Poly Haven scanned trees (island_tree_01, jacaranda_tree, fir_tree_01, pine_tree_01, tree_small_02, fir_sapling, pine_sapling_small)
not_included.why: Photorealistic but unusable: .bin geometry 60MB-950MB per tree, 200k-2M tris each (even saplings ~400k tris). Rejected on size, not quality. Source: https://polyhaven.com — CC0.
not_included.tried: api.polyhaven.com/files/<slug> 1k — bin sizes verified before downloading

not_included.why: Photorealistic scan but 200,610 tris, 7.2MB .bin, 103 meshes — too heavy for a repeated roadside prop. Replaced by Quaternius streetlight (664 tris).
175k-270k tris, 6-8MB .bin, and flat facades only (not full buildings). Replaced by Quaternius full buildings.

No genuine vehicle seat or dashboard model found on Poly Pizza (searches: seat, steering, dashboard) or Poly Haven (no vehicles). Only a steering wheel was usable. 'The cockpit' (Romain Revert, poly.pizza/m/ccQg0nHGSA9) is a stylized art-scene diorama, not a clean cabin part — rejected. Recommend modelling seat/dashboard in code or sourcing later.

No free CC0/CC-BY photorealistic truck found. Sketchfab photogrammetry trucks need an account + API key and per-model licence checks; Quaternius Ultimate Vehicles Pack (quaternius.com) is the same low-poly models as here, distributed as Google Drive zips. A photorealistic hero truck needs a paid asset or custom modelling.

Requires a free API key (401 without x-auth-token). Worked around by scraping public model/search pages (no key needed) and extracting the embedded __SERVER_APP_STATE__ metadata + static.poly.pizza GLB URLs.
